full_prompt_en: A square high-contrast photographic collage places a huge cropped woman's face across the right half of the frame and a cluster of dark-clad men on the left. Only one heavily shadowed eye, the bridge of her nose, and dark lips are fully readable. Her pale skin is nearly white against the thick black eyeliner, lashes, eyebrow, and hair. One hand with dark polished nails touches the lower edge of her mouth, adding a small intimate gesture to the oversized close-up. Behind her, several men appear at different scales and depths, dressed in dark jackets. A man in round glasses near the center holds a hand close to his chin; another man's face peers out from behind him, while a partly cropped figure in a dark hat enters at the far left. A rough scarlet-red patch fills the upper-left background and breaks the otherwise strict black-and-white scheme. The faces overlap without a natural shared perspective, making the assembly feel like cut photographs pasted into a single graphic image. Dense black areas join clothing and hair into one dark mass, and pale face fragments emerge abruptly from it. Visible grain, hard tonal transitions, and slightly imperfect cut edges give the work a handmade print or magazine montage quality. The right eye becomes the strongest focal point, while smaller gazes in the left group pull attention sideways. The composition is crowded, asymmetrical, and deliberately unstable, yet the red corner keeps its energy contained. It feels fashionable and unsettling at once, using the contrast between a monumental private close-up and a watchful public group.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形高反差摄影拼贴把一张巨大的女性局部面孔放在画面右半边，把一群穿深色衣服的男子放在左边。她只有一只罩在浓影中的眼、鼻梁及深色嘴唇能完整看清。浅色皮肤在厚重黑眼线、睫毛、眉毛和头发前几乎显白。一只涂深色指甲油的手触及嘴边，为放大的特写增添细小而私密的动作。她身后几名男子以不同大小和深度出现，身穿深色外套。中央附近一个戴圆眼镜的男子把手靠近下巴；另一张男子面孔从其后探出，左边缘还切入一位戴深色帽子的局部人物。粗糙的猩红色块填满左上背景，打破其余部分严格的黑白色制。面孔相互重叠，却没有自然一致的透视，让组合显得像裁下的照片被贴进一张图形画面。密集黑色把衣服与头发连成一整块暗面，浅色面孔碎片从中突然浮现。可见颗粒、硬朗的明度跳变与略不完美的裁切边缘，使作品具有手工印刷或杂志蒙太奇质感。右侧眼睛是最强焦点，左侧较小人物的目光则把注意力横向拉开。构图拥挤、不对称并刻意不稳定，但红色角落收束了能量。它既时髦又令人不安，借巨大而私密的特写与警觉的公共群体形成对比。
style_prompt_en: Photographic collage uses stark black-and-white cutouts and one flat vermilion field to create immediate graphic tension. Fragments sit at incompatible scales, with a sharply cropped pale plane beside smaller layered silhouettes. Ink-deep blacks merge separate elements, while blown white highlights isolate eyes, lips, and hands. Grain and rough printed texture remain visible, preventing the image from feeling digitally clean. Hard cuts, partial faces, and unequal spacing create a restless rhythm without requiring a natural perspective. A single red block anchors the upper area and intensifies the monochrome contrast. The strongest gaze or dark accent sits near an edge, drawing attention across competing faces and shadows. The result feels like an experimental fashion editorial or handmade magazine montage: bold, compressed, and psychologically charged.
style_prompt_zh: 摄影拼贴用强烈黑白剪片和一块平涂朱红色域制造即时的图形张力。碎片以不相容的尺度并置，大幅裁切的浅色平面紧挨较小的层叠剪影。墨黑把不同元素接成一体，几乎过曝的白色高光则孤立出眼、唇与手。颗粒和粗糙印刷肌理保持可见，使画面不会变得数码般洁净。硬切边、局部面孔和不均匀间距形成躁动节奏，无须自然一致的透视。单一红色块固定上部区域并强化黑白反差。最强的目光或深色重音位于边缘附近，引导注意力穿过竞争的面孔与阴影。效果像实验性时装编辑画面或手制杂志蒙太奇：大胆、压缩，且充满心理张力。
theme_en: A cropped glamorous face overlays a crowd of men beneath a red graphic field
theme_zh: 一张被裁切的华丽女性面孔叠覆在男子人群前，背后是红色平面
name: William Klein
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
